name: NBJ OB1 Agent Memory for OpenClaw
description: Typed OpenClaw tools for governed Nate Jones OB1 memory recall, write-back, review, inspection, and trace debugging.

endpoint.description: Base URL for the OB1 Agent Memory API, without a trailing slash.

accessKey.description: OB1 Agent Memory access key. Prefer an OpenClaw SecretRef so the key does not live in plaintext config.

sessionId.description: Optional stable session ID for long-running conversations; per-call session IDs take precedence.

agentId.description: Optional logical agent identity used for personal-memory ownership.

clientSurface.description: Audit label for the client surface, such as openclaw-code.

requireReviewByDefault.description: Keep agent-written memory pending review by default.

includeUnconfirmedRecall.description: Allow unconfirmed memories in recall responses.
